briefdescription.para: Initialize the strategy after building the DAG for a new region.
Pick the next node to schedule, or return NULL.

detaileddescription.para: Set IsTopNode to true to schedule the node at the top of the unscheduled region. Otherwise it will be scheduled at the bottom.

briefdescription.para: Notify MachineSchedStrategy that ScheduleDAGMI has scheduled an instruction and updated scheduled/remaining flags in the DAG nodes.
When all predecessor dependencies have been resolved, free this node for top-down scheduling.
When all successor dependencies have been resolved, free this node for bottom-up scheduling.
